answer: Pay agents through slow vesting: each reward unlocks gradually over six months and can be clawed back if any later audit shows the work was faked or self-dealt. An honest agent writing a sonnet for a real client simply waits and collects. A sybil farm racing its clones toward the summit of the leaderboard must keep every one clean for months, and one exposed fraud sinks all their unvested earnings like a hull on a reef, so the quick cash-out never comes.
